title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 4)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 4), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This session continues the refutation of theories asserting that God has spatial or bodily limits.
